description: This file defines a module that exports a function to set up a counter widget in a web page element. It initializes a counter, updates the DOM element with the counter value, and adds a click event listener to increment the counter.

methods.name: setupCounter(element)
methods.description: Initializes and sets up a counter within a DOM element, updating its display on click.

methods.name: setCounter
methods.description: Updates the counter value and the innerHTML of the given DOM element.
